name: Sikorsky S-64 Skycrane
summary: A giant insect-like crane helicopter with a narrow open frame, flown for firefighting, logging and heavy lifting.

wings: Six-blade main rotor on a huge mast
engines: Two turboshafts in pods on the top of the frame
Exhaust at the rear of each pod
fuselage: Narrow open frame with no cabin, a cockpit pod hung at the front
Long spidery legs with large wheels
Often carries a water tank or load slung under the belly
tail: Tail rotor on a slim fin

tellTales: Insect-like open frame with no cabin behind the cockpit
Six-blade rotor over a skeletal body
Long spindly landing legs with a load slung underneath

confusedWith.howToTell: The Chinook has two rotors on a boxy fuselage; the S-64 has one rotor on an open frame.
The K-MAX is much smaller with two intermeshing rotors and a single engine; the S-64 is a huge single-rotor machine.
The CH-53E has a full enclosed cabin and a rear ramp; the S-64 is an open frame with no cabin.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
